note: Expected values are hand-computed from the stated numbers (E = P×t; cost = E×tariff; runtime = E/P; charge time = E/(P×0.85 default efficiency); panels = ceil(need/(W×sun×0.75 default)). Held-out cases are never given to the evolution engine.
